instruction: Follow all artists of all classical-genre songs in any of my playlists on Spotify.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) with a set-valued goal. Knowledge flow: show_profile -> username, show_account_passwords -> password, login -> token; show_playlist_library reveals the user's playlists (nullary library-shown gate, since one paginated call reveals all), show_playlist reveals the songs of a playlist (playlist-shown gate on the static contains facts), show_song reveals genre/artists (song-shown gate). follow_artist is only applicable for an artist of a shown song whose genre is the constant classical, so non-classical artists can never be followed (matches the exact-set evaluation); (not (following ?ar)) deduplicates artists shared by several classical songs. Because the actual library contents are unknown, the problem is a representative instance (2 playlists, 3 songs, 2 classical artists, 1 pop artist); the classical artists to follow are domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can state the full task goal without quantification. The planner may skip show_song for the non-classical song since it does not contribute to the goal; a real agent must inspect every song to learn its genre. The extra ?p / ?s parameters of show-song / follow-artist are not API arguments (null in action_params).
